speaker: Heather Adkins (VP, Security Engineering) and Sophie Schmieg (Senior Staff Cryptography Engineer)
verbatim: We're setting a timeline for post-quantum cryptography migration to 2029.
headline: Google has set 2029 as its internal deadline to complete post-quantum cryptography migration across its infrastructure.
resolution_criteria: Resolves VERIFIED if Google publicly states, by 31 Dec 2029 (plus grace), that its own infrastructure's post-quantum cryptography migration is complete, consistent with the phased plan in the same post (store-now-decrypt-later priority items by end of 2027). PARTIALLY_VERIFIED if the store-now-decrypt-later-priority subset is done but the full migration is not. NOT_VERIFIED if neither has happened by the deadline plus grace.
